nonmonotone_raw_route_extension.claim: Every nested raw path of the same endpoints costs at least 8^(199/200) plus its inward cut crossings beyond the endpoint-implied 0 or 1. Extra cut entries therefore cannot be hidden by rerouting a raw carrier.

scope.budget: Use the inherited H4 target and all source reservations, replacing only 1710 raw legs by 400 direct rank8 legs and adding the 112 comparison rank1 legs. Apply per native template; no unrestricted cross-template coding theorem is asserted.
scope.local_information: All initial inside common and private fields are conditioned upon; all inside final common and private fields must have their required target values. This permits global inside decoding, arbitrary dirty mixtures, and feedback. No fixed-original-history premise is used.
scope.native_common_slots: Keep the native common MOVE chart endpoints and multiplicities. Payloads, local operations, and chronology may be recoded arbitrarily.
scope.not_claimed: No obstruction for a changed common MOVE skeleton, changed reserved packet endpoints, or another unpaid source of cross-cut communication; no global kappa impossibility or sufficiency of eight added legs for all 96 duties.
scope.raw_paths: 400 raw carrier paths retain their initial and final charts. Monotone paths have exactly 368 inward entries; arbitrary nested paths have their extra inward entries charged by the proved moment inequality.
scope.reserved_packets: 104 hub-to-firstY facet legs and 8 unhosted facet-to-hub legs keep their chart endpoints, but may be arbitrarily recoded. All 112 contribute zero inward cut capacity.

universal_edge_weighting_limit.proposition: For every nonempty cut generated upward by odd active port lines, the even-parity hyperplane is outside and the full hub is inside. Hence every nonnegative weighted family of eight-deficit cuts, normalized against all allowed nested binary-chart MOVEs, has sum(weights)<=1 and objective<=8.
universal_edge_weighting_limit.scope: This bounds the strength of that spatial-cut dual. It neither provides informative fields at the even hyperplane nor asserts an eight-call completion. Acquisition and decoding costs remain unpriced by these cuts.
